commit 0ace039ad372b36ee6c30bb6c07ab719bb1a3311
Author:     Justin Tracey <jtracey@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Thu Jun 11 12:46:00 2026 -0400
Commit:     Justin Tracey <jtracey@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Thu Jun 11 12:46:00 2026 -0400

    Bug 2043258: Use custom scheme redirect target to get Yahoo working with external browser OAuth flow. r=darktrojan
    
    This enables the `useSchemeRedirect` setting, and adjusts what we consider
    acceptable callback URIs to accommodate our Yahoo OAuth provider config.
    
    If Yahoo logins stop working because of invalid redirect targets, it's likely
    because Yahoo changed the config again, and reverting this patch (either the
    whole thing or just the `mailnews/base/src/OAuth2Providers.sys.mjs` file) should
    fix it, though it will also disable the external browser flow for Yahoo
    accounts. If you want to try to fix it without disabling the external browser
    flow, have someone with access to the Yahoo OAuth panel check what redirect
    targets are accepted, pick one that isn't https, and modify
    OAuth2Providers.sys.mjs accordingly.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D302856

diff --git a/mailnews/base/src/OAuth2.sys.mjs b/mailnews/base/src/OAuth2.sys.mjs
index 249a6f26627..e42fa0b367a 100644
--- a/mailnews/base/src/OAuth2.sys.mjs
+++ b/mailnews/base/src/OAuth2.sys.mjs
@@ -1050,7 +1050,10 @@ export class OAuth2URLHandler {
     }
 
     const url = URL.parse(data);
-    if (url.pathname != "/callback") {
+    if (
+      (url.host == "oauth2" && url.pathname != "/callback") ||
+      (url.host == "oauth" && url.pathname != "/yahoo")
+    ) {
       return;
     }
     const state = url.searchParams.get("state");
diff --git a/mailnews/base/src/OAuth2Providers.sys.mjs b/mailnews/base/src/OAuth2Providers.sys.mjs
index 2963d8410a9..ba3dbc5c0e5 100644
--- a/mailnews/base/src/OAuth2Providers.sys.mjs
+++ b/mailnews/base/src/OAuth2Providers.sys.mjs
@@ -227,8 +227,9 @@ var kIssuers = new Map([
         "dj0yJmk9WVZUaWRNUUZSQTBNJmQ9WVdrOVNqbHJUMGhtTkU4bWNHbzlNQT09JnM9Y29uc3VtZXJzZWNyZXQmc3Y9MCZ4PTgz",
       authorizationEndpoint: "https://api.login.yahoo.com/oauth2/request_auth",
       tokenEndpoint: "https://api.login.yahoo.com/oauth2/get_token",
-      redirectionEndpoint: "https://127.0.0.1",
+      redirectionEndpoint: "net.thunderbird://oauth/yahoo",
       usePKCE: true,
+      useSchemeRedirect: true,
     },
   ],
   [
diff --git a/mailnews/base/src/components.conf b/mailnews/base/src/components.conf
index e23d00cc985..33c8a8a8e00 100644
--- a/mailnews/base/src/components.conf
+++ b/mailnews/base/src/components.conf
@@ -32,7 +32,7 @@ Classes = [
         "contract_ids": ["@mozilla.org/mail/oauth2-url-handler;1"],
         "esModule": "resource:///modules/OAuth2.sys.mjs",
         "constructor": "OAuth2URLHandler",
-        "categories": {"net-thunderbird-url": "oauth2"},
+        "categories": {"net-thunderbird-url": ["oauth", "oauth2"]},
     },
     {
         "cid": "{c39265a0-629a-487e-b75a-baeb367495a8}",
diff --git a/mailnews/mailnews.js b/mailnews/mailnews.js
index 9533dbe5635..74720e72e1c 100644
--- a/mailnews/mailnews.js
+++ b/mailnews/mailnews.js
@@ -1065,7 +1065,7 @@ pref("mailnews.oauth.usePrivateBrowser", false);
 // Use the system browser for OAuth instead of a Thunderbird window.
 pref("mailnews.oauth.useExternalBrowser", true);
 // Use a net.thunderbird: URL instead of localhost for redirection.
-pref("mailnews.oauth.useSchemeRedirect", false);
+pref("mailnews.oauth.useSchemeRedirect", true);
 
 pref("test.loghelper.loglevel", "Warn");
title: Bug 2043258: Use custom scheme redirect target to get Yahoo working with external browser OAuth flow. r=darktrojan
